item.title: Report: Penn State Hiring Tyson Veidt as Linebackers Coach
item.description: Penn State's coaching staff continues to fill out. The Nittany Lions are hiring Tyson Veidt as their next linebackers coach, according to a report by 247Sports' Keegan Nickoson. Veidt spent the previous two seasons as Cincinnati's defensive coordinator, but they've agreed to a mutual parting of ways, according to the report. item.title: Iowa State Transfer QB Rocco Becht Commits to Penn State
item.description: Penn State has its quarterback. As expected, Iowa State transfer quarterback Rocco Becht is head to Penn State, following head coach Matt Campbell, offensive coordinator Taylor Mouser and quarterbacks coach Jake Waters, all of whom he worked with in Ames. Becht has one year of eligibility remaining after spending four seasons as a Cyclone, including three as a starter. item.title: Penn State Picks Up Big Commitment From Iowa State RB Transfer Carson Hansen
item.description: The Nittany Lions are staying hot on the recruiting trail. Penn State added a commitment from Iowa State transfer running back Carson Hansen on Sunday evening, continuing a string of commitments both from portal players and high school recruits over the weekend. Hansen was the leading rusher for the Cyclones in each of the last two seasons.
